title: Independently audit Clifford pointwise overlap and phase bounds
body:
This adds an independent audit of PR #5526’s core pointwise Clifford tensor theorem in `research/clifford-pointwise-audit/`. No substantive gap was found in PROOF.md Sections 2–5 under the stated hypotheses. The contribution adds proof clarifications and complementary exact checks; the theorem and constants remain Ali Romman’s and the credited predecessors’ work.

The audit makes the Gaussian-dyadic phase lifts explicit, checks the residual-form counting argument, and distinguishes fixed coefficients from width-dependent coefficients. Separate literal-matrix and exhaustive binary-symplectic checkers corroborate the overlap counts and Gram bounds.

Exact pins:

- Canonical base: `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`
- Contribution: `1c1c04d1302d109a838faf96b925e4020b215b24`
- Reviewed PR #5526 source: `45f7de73b168721cdf7ec8c1769b1b594493716a`

Verification on Python 3.12.14, using only the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-pointwise-audit
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clifford-pointwise-audit --check-source-history
```

Both passed. All six registered commands pass, including 22 deliberate-defect/corruption rejections. Export integrity passed, and all six final committed commands also passed in a read-only export without Git, with identical outputs and unchanged files. Reproduction details and results are recorded in the package.

Internal review used an independently deriving verifier and a separate skeptical reviewer. No blocking findings remain; phase and quantifier clarifications and a mutation-label correction were incorporated. These are AI-assisted reviews, not independent human review or formal verification.

The actual passive-caller implication, later repair theorem and invoice, downstream applications, physical costs and full multiplication theorem remain outside this audit. The complete predecessor suite and selected-construction cold replay were not run. Frozen predecessors and the selected result are unchanged.

See the [package README](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1c1c04d1302d109a838faf96b925e4020b215b24/research/clifford-pointwise-audit/README.md) for the proof audit, review resolutions, verification receipts and Open next questions. Coordination is in [Discussion #5236](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5236#discussioncomment-19175829). The next outstanding task is to audit the actual passive-caller implication against its source implementation and allowed observations; check current Discussion claims and PR overlap before taking it.

Prepared for DLamdata with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution and source notices are retained.
